name: ESF Summer Camps at The Haverford School
description_short: ESF day camp on the The Haverford School campus in Haverford for boys and girls from rising preschool to grade 10. Campers are grouped by grade, swim with Red Cross certified lifeguards and instructors, and pick from more than 60 activities across sports, arts, science, engineering and technology.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel by March 15, 2027 for a refund less the $50 registration fee (a full cancellation also costs $300 per child); from March 16 to June 1, 2027, a credit instead of a refund; no refunds or credits after June 1. An optional protection plan covers injury or illness.
notes: Standard 2027 rates for Junior, Senior, Multi-Sports and Tennis camps (rising PreS to 10th): 2 weeks $1,580 up to 8 weeks $6,080; early bird until February 1, 2027 is $1,480 for 2 weeks. Half day option for PreS and PreK (9:00 to 1:00) $1,260 for 2 weeks. Specialty STEAM camps (rising K to 6) $790 a week standard. Young Leaders Program $1,580 for 4 weeks. 5+ weeks save $30 a week. Weeks need not be consecutive. Standard hours 9:00 to 3:00. Club OT extended day is offered after camp. Optional lunch program at extra cost. No camp Monday July 5, 2027. PreSeason and Encore specialty weeks (June 14, August 16 and August 23) meet at ESF headquarters in Bryn Mawr, not at this campus, and are not counted here.
